description: This file contains a utility class 'SegmentBuilder' for encoding and decoding data into an ArraySegment<byte>, including appending bytes and strings, and reading them back.

classes.name: SegmentBuilder
classes.description: A static utility class that provides methods for encoding data into and decoding data from ArraySegments, including appending bytes and strings, and reading them back.

methods.name: CalculateAppendSize (ReadOnlySpan<byte> memory)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to append a byte span, including space for length prefix.

methods.name: CalculateAppendSize (string str)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to append a string, including space for length prefix.

methods.name: Append (ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int writerOffset, ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)
methods.description: Appends a byte span to the segment at the specified writer offset, updating the offset after writing.

methods.name: Append (ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int writerOffset, string str)
methods.description: Appends a string to the segment at the specified writer offset, encoding it as bytes, or writes -1 if null.

methods.name: ReadNextBytes (ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int readerOffset)
methods.description: Reads the next byte array segment from the data, updating the reader offset.

methods.name: ReadNextString (ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int readerOffset)
methods.description: Reads the next string from the data segment, decoding from bytes, returning null if size is negative.
